year_over_year.missing_reason: BLS did not collect October 2025 survey data because of the lapse in appropriations and could not publish October 2025 indexes for most CPI series; therefore October 2026 12-month changes are unavailable for those series.
year_over_year.official_release_lines: BLS release states the limitation and table uses '-' for most 12-month series.
year_over_year.model_rule: Preserve null with explicit missing reason; never zero-fill, interpolate or synthesize an official YoY value.

fed_context.waller_conditional_statement: Waller said core CPI at 0.3% m/m or higher should prompt consideration of a 50bp December move. Actual core print meets that stated threshold; this is one governor's view, not an FOMC decision.

pre_release_kalshi_snapshot.classification: PRE_RELEASE market pricing; not a post-CPI repricing.

fed_context.disagreement: Different instruments/providers and timestamps; preserve separately, do not average. No post-release market-pricing update independently verified by 13:31 UTC.

macro_event.interpretation: Both headline and core monthly prints were 0.1 percentage point above the Reuters preview consensus. The core print meets Waller's stated 0.3% conditional threshold. Annual headline/core comparison is unavailable; do not compare to September's 3.7%/2.6% as if an October YoY print existed.

post_release_okx.classification: STALE; excluded from post-release cross-venue comparison.

market_observations.conclusion: No synchronized post-release multi-venue snapshot with provider timestamps. The small difference between two Kraken retrievals is not a valid CPI event return and cannot establish a price reaction.

model_admission.cpi_headline_mom_sa: Admit with BLS release ID, first-release vintage and exact timestamp.
model_admission.cpi_core_mom_sa: Admit with BLS release ID, first-release vintage and exact timestamp.
model_admission.source_independence: BLS is primary; Reuters provides pre-release consensus and Waller context; Kalshi pricing snapshot is a separate prediction-market source, but predates release.
